title: C02 · Boundary exchange feasibility envelope
question: At which external exchange coefficients and ambient temperatures do individual and joint thermal constraints switch for constant equal duty and the released ramp on the pinned high-loading phantom?
method: Locally preregistered finite-volume RK2 scan and bisection at fixed 70 s, uniform 1.83 mg Fe/mL myocardial loading and clamped SAR. Discovery at 0.75 mm, cold and room repeats at 0.50 mm, half-step checks around joint transitions, component-localized extrema and signed energy accounting.
result: At −150 °C the myocardial cold endpoint binds first, in disjoint brackets across meshes. At +22 °C the surrounding solution fails the final-stage rate screen before any terminal-temperature failure, with matching coarse and fine brackets. The ramp fails the all-time rate screen throughout.

numerical_claims.h_units: W/(m² K), lower value passes and upper value fails

limitations: Constant effective boundary, synthetic voxel geometry, modeled loading, no measured coefficient for this phantom.
Finite bracket resolution, intermediate ambients checked only at 0.75 mm, no continuum error guarantee.
Thermal screens only. No biological or mechanical outcomes, no independent human expert review.
coordinator_checks: Full offline re-integration and comparison: 137 rows; successful exit 0.
Source diff inspection and independent h=0 invariance, conservation, constraint/domain and mesh-bracket cross-checks.

scientific_assessment.limit: Fixed-horizon brackets are not measured environmental tolerances.
